The '''Phorliss system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Dolomar sector/Legends|Dolomar sector]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the world of [[Phorliss]].
